title: Book Three · Chapter 150: The Last Work Date
story:
On Saturday, Ronan reaches the workshop before nine.

Anna's bus left two hours earlier. He thinks about it as he puts his water near the counter, then opens the customer book.

The man with the narrow cupboard is coming at ten. He brought back the missing height during the week. The adults have finished his cupboard and checked the doorway size.

Ronan finds the man's drawing. The arrow from the hall is still beside it.

At ten, the man arrives with another adult to help carry the piece. Ronan meets them at the front.

Mr Sun is checking a large job at the back. Ronan tells the man and finds him a place to sit.

“Can I look at it first?”

“Yes. I will get the drawing.”

He puts the paper beside the cupboard. The man compares the height and points to the inside shelf.

“Can that come out?”

Ronan checks the note from Mr Sun.

“Yes. Mr Sun will show you.”

He gives the question to Mr Sun when he comes forward. Mr Sun lifts the shelf out and explains the two supports beneath it.

The man tries it himself. Ronan holds the paper while he puts the shelf back.

After the payment, the adults carry the cupboard toward the door. Ronan moves a stool from the path and keeps the drawing with the receipt.

At eleven, he notices the clock. Anna's visit is starting now.

He pictures her outside the school with the notebook against her coat. Her mother is there too. By now, they have finished the long morning journey.

He wants to know the first thing she sees through the door.

At the counter, the cupboard drawing is still beside his hand. He moves his water bottle farther from the open customer book and leaves space for the next person.

He could have chosen the visit. He remembers Mr Sun leaving that choice open.

Ronan puts his pencil down for a moment. The morning has gone well, and he still feels the empty place beside Anna.

He thinks of the stair question in her notebook. She can ask someone there about the sizes. He wants her to have time for the whole answer.

A sound comes from the doorway. Ronan lifts his head.

He will hear her news after the journey. This morning, he has his own name beside the last work date. He draws the customer book nearer, ready to listen to the person at the door.

A woman comes to the counter with a small wooden box. Ronan looks up and asks her name.

She wants a new handle. He asks her to point to the place and writes her answer clearly.

Dad comes to check the box with her. Ronan leaves them room and brings the next customer's papers to the front.

At twelve, Mr Sun checks the last date.

“All three,” he says.

He pays Ronan two yuan. The three new mornings have brought six in all. Ronan's work money is now twenty-seven yuan.

He returns the pencil and takes his cloth from beside the table.

“Thank you for these mornings,” Mr Sun says.

Ronan thanks him too. Dad lifts a hand from the back. He still has his own afternoon work.

Outside, Ronan takes a drink and lets the cold air reach his face. He walks home for lunch with the last two yuan in his pocket.

At home, he puts it with the twenty-five. Then he opens his school book near the window and starts the first holiday task.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

compare＝对照、比较；support＝托住物体的支撑；receipt＝收据；handle＝把手。

## 理解问题

1. 谁制作、核验并搬运柜子？Ronan实际接待、查明和整理了哪些部分？
2. 三次新工作是否都完成？新收入和工资总余额各是多少？

## 读句子

**He returns the pencil and takes his cloth from beside the table.**

拆开看：He / returns the pencil / and takes his cloth / from beside the table.

他／交还铅笔／并拿起自己的布／从桌子旁边。
